name: off
trans: ────I pray that...

name: off
text:
大きな空で羽ばたく
真乃の勇気となりますように
trans:
I pray that Mano has the courage she needs as she
spreads her wings in the vast sky.

name: 真乃
trans: ───Producer-san...

name: 真乃
text: ありがとうございました……っ
trans: Thank you very much...

name: プロデューサー
text:
俺は羽をあげて、ほんの少し
背中を押しただけだよ
trans:
I just gave you your wings and pushed you forward a
little.

name: プロデューサー
text:
大きな羽にできたのも
羽ばたいたのも、全部、真乃の力だ
trans:
These big wings you've grown, and how you've flown
with them... All of it is because of your strength.

name: 真乃
trans: All of this is because... you believed in me...

name: 真乃
text:
……プロデューサーさんが
ここまで導いてくださったおかげです
trans: ...It's all because you were there to guide me.

name: 真乃
text: ────あれだけ、追いかけていた夢が……
trans: ────That's the only reason that my dreams...

name: 真乃
trans: Are as close as they are.

name: プロデューサー
text: はは、まだ終わりじゃないぞ
trans: Haha, it's not over yet.

name: プロデューサー
trans: You should get going.

name: 真乃
trans: Okay...

name: 真乃
trans: Um...

name: 真乃
text:
届けたい人、プロデューサーさんも……
なので……
trans:
Producer-san... you're also someone that... I want
these songs to reach, so...

name: 真乃
text: よかったら、受け取ってください
trans: If you don't mind, please accept them.

name: スタッフ
trans: ──Sorry, after this...

name: 真乃
text:
次が、本当に……
最後の曲に、なってしまいました……っ
trans: This next song... really is the last one......

name: 真乃
text: 私も、とってもさみしいです……
trans: I get a little lonely thinking about it too...

name: 真乃
text:
……ですが
また必ずみなさんのもとへ、会いに来ると……約束します
trans:
...But,
I'll come to see you all again... I promise.

name: 真乃
text:
最後なので、よかったら
みなさんも一緒に歌ってください
trans:
Since this is the last song, feel free to sing along
with me.

name: 真乃
trans: Now then...────

name: 真乃
trans: H-Huh...?

name: 真乃
trans: ......This song... It's my... my first solo...

name: 真乃
trans: Howa......
